content:
dmitri: Heads-up — console spike on small-batch latency for /v1/embeddings fastpath, 99p jumped ~120ms in last hour :thinking_face:

maria: saw that. can you paste an example request shape? are these 1-3 vectors or single huge dim vectors?

dmitri: mostly tiny requests, usually 1-2 vectors, dims=1536. headers show X-Embed-Unit: auto and no shape hint. sample: `[{\"text\": \"q1\"}]`

alex: sounds like prefetch/mini-batch path is getting cold-started with lots of singletons. proposal: route requests with <=3 vectors and dims <=2048 to the tiny-batch fastpath only when queue < 5 to avoid degenerate batching overhead.

sre-oncall: quota note — if we route more to tiny fastpath it could bypass chunked accounting and inflate per-tenant unit usage. need to add a telemetry metric: `mini_batch_throttle_ratio` and `mini_batch_unit_delta`

maria: agree on metrics. also suggest adding a header signal `X-Embed-Shape: mini` so clients opt-in and we can A/B measure. UX: console should show mini-batch fraction per route.

zara: on console side — we can add a small card: "mini-batch rate" + 99/95/50p latency and a toggle to show only tenants generating >10% mini batches. cheap and actionable.

dmitri: can we also capture `batch_fill_time_ms` in traces? helps differentiate waiting for batch vs execution.

alex: snippet to detect tiny request in router (pseudo):
```
if (payload.count <= 3 && dims <= 2048 && queue.length < 5) {
  route = FASTPATH_MINI;
} else {
  route = DEFAULT;
}
```

maria: +1 to `X-Embed-Shape`. we'll default off for now. rollout plan: enable header opt-in for internal SDK, collect 48h, then can flip console visible metric.

sre-oncall: adding alarms: if mini_batch_unit_delta > 20% baseline AND 99p latency > 200ms for 10m -> paging. otherwise warn.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline started for `router/mini-fastpath-toggle` -> canary (10%) -> will post status here. :rocket:

zara: i'll mock the dashboard card and post screenshots to #eng-platform when canary metrics are in.

dmitri: sweet. assign action items? alex to land router gate, maria to expose header in SDK, zara to mock console card, sre-oncall to add telemetry/alarm. i'll follow up on results in 24h. :thumbsup:
